draftRules.name: Standard
draftRules.description: Three random starters from the pool.

draftRules.name: Balanced Draft
draftRules.description: Three starters that share no types, when the pool allows it.

draftRules.name: Blind Draft
draftRules.description: The three starters stay hidden until you pick one.

draftRules.name: Type Focus
draftRules.description: Three starters of the type you choose, when the pool has enough.

tokens.name: Ball Bundle
tokens.description: Start the run with 5 Great Balls.

tokens.name: Field Kit
tokens.description: Start the run with 3 Super Potions and a Revive.

tokens.name: Research Focus
tokens.description: Reward drafts offer currency and attribute items about 1.8x as often. Still random.

tokens.name: Aggressive Focus
tokens.description: Reward drafts offer stat boosters about 1.8x as often. Still random.

tokens.name: Defensive Focus
tokens.description: Reward drafts offer healing items about 1.8x as often. Still random.

tokens.name: Transformation Focus
tokens.description: Reward drafts offer transformation items and key items about 1.8x as often. Still random.

licenses.name: Type Specialist License
licenses.description: Adds the Type Focus draft rule: choose a type for your three starters.

licenses.name: Field Medic License
licenses.description: Adds the Field Kit (healing items) to your preparation choices.

licenses.name: Research License
licenses.description: Opens the Research starter pool in the Starter Laboratory.
